integrity_notes: The sharp bound follows from a complete discriminant-and-one-variable proof. Exact polynomial identities are replayable with standard-library source code; finite numerical comparisons are diagnostic and not evidence of exhaustive coverage. No independent audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Exact statement restricted to real three-atom L4 and the explicitly defined pair of overlapping conditional expectations. It does not address complex scalar fields, other p, unequal atom masses, or arbitrary partitions; historical indexing may be incomplete.
title: Sharp numerical radius of a three-point conditional-expectation commutator
